title: Multi-stage recipe scaling with yield loss and rounding
text: A recipe uses 453 grams ingredient X, 41 mL ingredient Y, and 425 grams ingredient Z to produce 14 servings. When scaling to 31 servings, ingredient X experiences 22.19% yield loss during cooking (so you must start with more), and ingredient Y must be measured in multiples of 29 mL (rounded up). If the pre-discount total cost exceeds 94.24, a discount 34.27% applies only to ingredient Z. Given unit costs cx=0.05 per gram, cy=0.006 per mL, cz=0.028 per gram, compute total cost and final amounts of each ingredient used.
